From Stone Free · Price: your body becomes the string, so damage to the string is damage to you.

Theme Matter and Life

  • 1: Your body unravels: reach 15 ft for Interact and Grapple, and you can squeeze through any gap. 1 action: string trap on a creature within your string's reach: it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{grabbed} for 1 round (@Check[reflex|against:stand]{Reflex} negates). 1 action: lash up to two creatures within your string's reach with taut string: @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[slashing]] damage (@Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}); on a failure the string tangles it, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} until the end of your next turn, and on a critical failure it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{grabbed} until the end of your next turn. Once per turn, your stand can bind a creature it hits with your string as part of a Strike (1 action): the string cuts for 1d6 extra slashing damage (2d6 at 5th, 3d6 at 13th), and it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{grabbed} until the end of your next turn (@Check[reflex|against:stand]{Reflex} negates); on a failed save the string bites in, 1d6 persistent bleed damage.
  • 5: The string trap restrains for 1 round on a critical failure, and the binding restrains until the end of your next turn on a critical failure. Surge: string net, @Template[burst|distance:15]{15-ft burst}: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{restrained} for 1 round (@Check[reflex|against:stand]{Reflex} negates).
  • 9: The surge string net is a @Template[burst|distance:20]{20-ft burst}.
  • 13: String reach 30 ft. Your surge net takes 1 action.
  • 17: You can sew wounds closed: allies heal @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[healing]] each turn while touched (once per round, max 1 minute).

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
